conceptual_model.accepted_geometry: A = union of actual accepted terrain/water geometry; accepted coverage and all world data remain authoritative.
conceptual_model.display_cells: S = 1mi cells whose intersection with A has positive area under the existing geometry precision policy. Edge/point contact alone does not create a filled cell. S is a display membership set, not new accepted area.
conceptual_model.full_fill: For C in S paint the full hex with its own biome tile. The painted portion outside A is display only; it never changes accepted area, water access, generator occupancy, object placement, locks, or save semantics.
conceptual_model.dominant_biome: Compute a_b = area(C intersect accepted geometry of biome b), aggregate all pieces of the same biome inside C, select the maximum a_b. Compare local intersection area, never parent region size or source hex centre. An explicit persisted local biome override takes precedence only for that cell's supported local biome attribute.
conceptual_model.proposed_tie_break: Analyst-owned in-scope detail: reuse an existing suitable common deterministic comparator; otherwise normalize area with the documented existing geometry precision, then choose the lexicographically smallest canonical biome ID using locale-independent codepoint comparison among equal maxima. Apply one rule to 2, 3, or more biomes; no RNG, translated label, object iteration order, hover order, or screen zoom.
conceptual_model.proposed_rim: Analyst-owned in-scope detail: R = union(edgeNeighbours(C) for C in S) minus S. Use the active 1mi grid; no corner-only neighbours, second ring, or expansion of the coarse6mi candidate set. Filter action availability by ordinary accepted-world generator rules without adding accepted terrain. Fix the intended treatment of internal cavities explicitly in spec: recommended all unaccepted edge-neighbours of S, including playable cavities; this operational definition follows ordinary adjacency and prevents arbitrary flood-fill hiding.
conceptual_model.semantic_warning: S/R are display and selection projections. A full-looking boundary cell must still report and edit only actual supported local state. A thin displayed rim is not a new 1mi world generator.

analyst_resolutions_in_scope: Reuse6mi visual card/editor shell and shared command pipeline only; do not reuse donor source6mi selection/edit handlers (selectedHexKey). Local adapter routes all edit targets by1mi identity.
Minimal cell-owned editing: biome override, local name, local note. No implicit editing of parent6mi region, parent-water shape, route geometry or fine hydrology.

Persist optional local-cell overrides keyed by stable1mi grid coordinates plus grid identity/version, through the existing document/command/history pipeline; do not key only by source6mi object, because a1mi cell may intersect several source cells.
Only accepted/display-filled cells are editable for terrain attributes. Empty candidates do not acquire accepted terrain through biome/name controls.

Use existing POI entity actions when offered; shared POI keeps exact same ID and footprint, never create a local duplicate. A shared-entity rename may legitimately appear in several intersecting cards, while cell-owned edits must not change neighbours.
Roads/trails/rivers/water and POI relevance use their actual common geometry/footprint contracts. Do not derive water access or object relevance from the full painted biome.

If generation is exposed on a candidate, invoke the existing ordinary generator under its actual availability rules; do not promise precisely1mi output. If necessary use the ordinary action's existing user-visible scope/preview, without a parent-source hover card.
Cavity policy, precision/tie comparator, override reset/clear, no-op behavior and unsupported-data states belong in spec, handled by analyst without a new owner gate.

Hover/focus H supplies temporary local read-only card; pointerleave/focusleave restores selected S. Click/tap/Enter on accepted cell selects S. Open edit form is pinned to S plus document revision; hover never changes target or writes/history/RNG. While a form is open use a separate inert local preview/tooltip so the form is not replaced.

Water cells allow local name/note; local biome edit cannot convert accepted water into land or change fine water geometry. For land cells supported local biome choices preserve actual water/terrain constraints.

Legacy saves lacking finePOI activation preserve existing Preview/Apply contract as a compact useful action; new data preserve existing autoactivation behavior. Remove persistent service status, not a meaningful pending action. Shared exactIDs and footprints remain unchanged.

acceptance.evidence: Same fixture six/one-mile screenshots with partial boundary cell and empty adjacent cell plus accepted-area snapshot.

acceptance.check: Saved/synthetic geometry cases cover unique maximum, repeated disjoint pieces of one biome,2-way equality and3-way equality. Local area aggregation gives expected biome; reversing source order/reopening/changing language/zoom does not change selection. Existing RNG state is byte-equivalent.
acceptance.evidence: Declared polygon inputs, local area table, chosen canonical ID and precision/tie rule. Reuse existing coverage where suitable; no random generation campaign.

acceptance.check: Opening1mi view, hovering/selecting, changing style/language, then returning6mi changes no accepted geometry, entity IDs, actual footprints, roads/rivers/water, RNG, document content, or history entry. Full visual tiles never turn their exterior into generated/accepted land.
acceptance.evidence: Before/after canonical document and RNG/history comparison on a saved map.

acceptance.check: Displayed rim consists only of unaccepted1mi edge-neighbours of S under the fixed cavity policy. Every candidate is distance1; no distance2+ candidate from a coarse6mi shell is shown. Candidate construction alone creates no terrain and consumes no RNG.
acceptance.evidence: S/R coordinate dump and annotated screenshot of concave edge, corner and cavity. Availability restriction is distinguished from geometric rim.

acceptance.evidence: Action mapping and one controlled existing fixture/replay or code trace under relevant existing checks; do not generate a new statistical corpus.

acceptance.check: Edit biome override, local name and note of A; B and all parent6mi raw fields/actual accepted geometry are unchanged. Cancel/no-op creates no mutation. risks.issue: Full visual tile may be confused with accepted area, causing hidden generated territory, wrong water access or edit target.
risks.mitigation: Separate A/S/R; accepted geometry remains source of generation/objects/water, immutable during view-only operations.

risks.issue: Rendering coarse6mi candidates through1mi grid yields several rows; an independently computed thin rim may point to impossible6mi generation targets.
risks.mitigation: Compute one-mile adjacency first and distinguish rim geometry from ordinary action availability; no promise of1mi generator.

risks.issue: A1mi cell can intersect multiple source cells; parent-keyed edits overwrite too much or disappear.
risks.mitigation: Stable1mi identity and separate persisted local attributes through common history.

risks.issue: Dominant-biome choice by parent size/source order/translated name or raw floating noise changes on redraw.
risks.mitigation: Aggregate local area, fix geometry precision and canonical deterministic tie-break.

risks.issue: Local route/POI facts can be fabricated by source6mi membership or by full biome painting.
risks.mitigation: Use exact actual line/footprint/water contracts; show neighbouring positive and negative cases.

risks.issue: A claim that all neighbour cards stay unchanged is false for shared POI entity edits.
risks.mitigation: Scope immutability guarantee to cell-owned attributes; shared entities intentionally update by sameID wherever present.

risks.issue: Local biome override may be incorrectly treated as creating/removing water or changing route geometry.
risks.mitigation: Declare supported biome set, preserve actual water/hydrology and existing validators; reject incompatible change atomically.

risks.issue: Readiness may be overstated from old496 evidence or stale latest fields.
risks.mitigation: New exactSHA independent acceptance, bounded file manifest and current owner decision precedence.

risks.issue: 6mi donor editor handlers use source6mi selectedHexKey and could silently edit an entire parent.
risks.mitigation: Reuse UI shell/commands with new1mi target adapter and pinned S+revision; verify changed-field diff at exact target. Root partition code observation requires exactSHA verification.
